mapper.sql: id, patient_id, exercise_type, duration_min, distance_km, calories_kcal, intensity, source_type, started_at, created_by_user_id, remark, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO patient_exercise_record ( patient_id, exercise_type, duration_min, distance_km, calories_kcal, intensity, source_type, started_at, created_by_user_id, remark, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{patientId}, #{exerciseType}, #{durationMin}, #{distanceKm}, #{caloriesKcal}, #{intensity}, #{sourceType}, #{startedAt}, #{createdByUserId}, #{remark}, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE patient_exercise_record SET exercise_type = #{exerciseType}, duration_min = #{durationMin}, distance_km = #{distanceKm}, calories_kcal = #{caloriesKcal}, intensity = #{intensity}, source_type = #{sourceType}, started_at = #{startedAt}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id} AND patient_id = #{patientId} AND is_deleted = 0
